choices: Optimisation in percent units, results converted to decimal daily units; omega scaled by 1e-4.

GARCH fitted on log returns dated 2010-01-04..2019-12-31 (first return uses the last 2009 close); variance recursion started at the sample variance; Nelder-Mead from 3 starts, best kept; alpha+beta<0.9999 enforced.
Closes: Cboe before 2016-10-28, FRED from then on (FRED NaN holidays dropped).
Simulated GARCH starts at the unconditional variance, then 500 burn-in sessions.
2019 pairs ending after 2019-12-31 (the 2019-12-31 starts, which end 2020-01-02) are dropped from the q fit, calibration and cross-section (unblinding rule).
sigma_t for a pair = GARCH conditional sd of the return realised on its next_session date; r = pair's dSn (simple return).
eta_hat_t = unweighted mean of e'/v over all options (both types) in the session; s_eta = sd (ddof=1) of eta_hat/sigma over sessions; no correction for sampling noise in eta_hat.
s_eps per type = sd (ddof=1) of (e'/v - eta_hat)/(sqrt(tau)*sigma) over that type's pairs, pooled across sessions.
Random draws (returns, eta, session draws, subsamples, eps) are common across the five kappas within a replication; bootstrap seed 10000+rep, shared by C and P.
Bootstrap index is the 252 test sessions; every test session has options of both types.
The truth uses the pair-weighted (per option) moments, pooled over all simulated sessions; the 200 years are 4 independent chunks of 50 years, each a fresh GARCH path with its own burn-in.
Training-year and test-year sessions are consecutive draws of one GARCH path (training immediately precedes test).
Pilot/full replication r uses SeedSequence([20261106, 1, r]); long simulation uses SeedSequence([20261106, 777]).
2020-like flag: test-year top-10 session share of R1 squared error, calls and puts summed, >= 0.5; the same flag is applied to both types of a replication.
